coverage.basis: Primary door: the MEC month grid, read four ways that agree — the static /calendar/ page (Sep: 44 occurrences / 22 slugs) and the replayed admin-ajax month feed for Sep/Oct/Nov/Dec 2026 (44/22, 39/19, 43/21, 40/19; 166 occurrence rows, 47 distinct slugs). Second door: the /events/ list archive, which shows 12 rows statically (Sep 9–17) but pages without limit over admin-ajax mec_list_load_more; through Dec 31 it yields 155 occurrence rows over 44 slugs, exactly the grid's set from Sep 9 onward (0 in-grid-not-list, 0 in-list-not-grid). The yesterday delta of "11 archive slugs vs 22 grid slugs" is simply the static archive being a 12-row rolling window (10 distinct slugs today), not a smaller catalogue. Collapse: 13 slugs recur (each one post, weekly or monthly occurrence links) → 13 series; 34 slugs appear once → 3 of them are past at recon (traps) and 31 are upcoming singles Sep 11–Dec 31 2026. The list door adds 9 posts beyond the pulled grids (8 Jan 2027 one-offs + CRUISE NIGHT, first date Feb 6 2027) — singles are never window-limited, so they are documented; publishedEventCount = 13 + 31 + 9 = 53. Series occurrences are materialized only inside the window from the grids' dated links (origin listed); Jan–Aug 2027 series rows in the list door are not materialized. Times/cadence text: event pages publish none; they come from poster img alt text (site text, quoted) or from the posters themselves (flyer rung, said so in note). Past listings: the Sep grid carries 12 occurrences before the recon date (3 one-offs + 9 series instances), and the archive shows Sep 9 as its first row; earlier months are reachable through the navigator but were not pulled. The 2027 month-feed HTTP 500 (Jan, Feb, Mar all tried) is a live site defect and is logged in openQuestions.
knownGaps: Series occurrences after 2026-12-31 (the list door lists them through Aug 2027) are not materialized; the window is the four grid-verified months.
CRUISE NIGHT (cruise-night-9) is a series that starts Feb 6 2027 with no in-window occurrence and no stated cadence; recorded as a single on its first date.
Months before Sep 2026 were not pulled; past-listing count covers the Sep grid only.

traps.label: CUBSCOUT — Sep 04 2026 (Expired!)
traps.why: A dated one-off post for the Sep 4 CubScout, already past at recon; its page shows "Expired!". It still sits in the September grid and the archive's past rows. The global config keeps past events (scraper-input.js config.allowPastEvents: true), so extracting it is correct behaviour — it is just not an upcoming event and is not counted in publishedEventCount.

traps.label: STYNK — Sep 05 2026 (Expired!)
traps.why: Past one-off (pit contest, doors 9pm, $8) listed in the September grid; page shows "Expired!". Kept only because allowPastEvents is on globally. The next STYNK (stynk-26, Nov 7) is a separate post and is documented as an event.

traps.label: LABOR DAY BEER BUST – BAR OPENS AT 2PM — Sep 07 2026 (Expired!)
traps.why: Past holiday one-off listed in the September grid; page shows "Expired!". Same allowPastEvents reasoning as the other September past rows. Twelve past occurrences sit in the Sep grid before the recon date (3 singles + 9 series instances).

traps.label: "Bears Cubs Otters and Other Furry Critters!" (B BAR poster tagline)
traps.why: The B BAR poster carries the tagline "Bears Cubs Otters and Other Furry Critters!" and a blurb (10 handle draft special, hosted by Pup Don, bare chest contest $100 cash prize). Run 20260909-072307 emitted the Thursday series under that tagline as its title (startDate 2026-09-10, FREQ=WEEKLY;BYDAY=TH, image IG_B-Bar-poster-GENERIC-2026.jpg) instead of the site's h4/h1 title "B BAR". It is the same event as series b-bar, not an additional one; an extra record under this title is a duplicate.

evidence.quote: alt="B BAR Every Thursday 10 Draft Special Bare Chest Contest"

traps.label: Cruise LA 2027 "Victory Party 11pm-2am" (Oct 17, flyer only)
traps.why: The shared Cruise LA Leather & Bootblack 2027 poster lists three blocks — Oct 16 Meet & Greet, Oct 17 Contest, Oct 17 Victory Party following the contest — but the site has posts for only the first two. The victory party is flyer text, not a published listing; an OCR path that mints a third record from it would be inventing an event the site does not list.

traps.label: Party Monster / The Birdcage / Shortbus / But I'm a Cheerleader (Movie Mondays poster)
traps.why: One poster carries four film titles, one per Monday. The site publishes them as ONE event, MOVIE MONDAYS, with four ?occurrence= dates. Four film-titled records would be duplicates of the series occurrences, and the films are not events in their own right.

evidence.quote: Sep 7 Party Monster Sep 14 Birdcage Sep 21 Shortbus Sep 28

traps.label: "Yearly Monthly Weekly Daily List" + "Select Month … 2034" (archive toolbar)
traps.why: The /events/ archive header is an MEC skin switcher (data-skin yearly/monthly/weekly/daily/list) and a month/year dropdown running 2026–2034. Text, not events. The month grid on /calendar/ has the same navigator (previous_month/current_month/next_month in the AJAX payload).

traps.label: /events/page/2/ → 200 "No event found!"
traps.why: The archive's Load More button links to /events/page/2/ (rel next), but that URL — and /page/3/ … /page/6/ — returns HTTP 200 with the archive shell and zero rows ("No event found!"). Real paging happens over admin-ajax mec_list_load_more, 12 rows per call. Crawling the page/N links yields nothing and must not be read as "the archive is only 12 events".

traps.label: class="mec-past-event" on future series occurrences in the grid
traps.why: Every occurrence link of a recurring event carries mec-past-event in the month grid and archive list — even Dec 2026 Thursdays — because MEC flags the SERIES (whose first date is years back), not the occurrence. Only one-off posts get the plain class. A reader that treats the class as "this date is past" would drop every series occurrence; the ?occurrence= date is the truth.

openQuestions.q: The MEC month feed returns HTTP 500 ("There has been a critical error on this website.") for every 2027 month (Jan/Feb/Mar tried) while Sep–Dec 2026 work and the list load-more pages happily into Aug 2027. Site-side PHP fault on grids past Dec 2026? Once the active month is Nov/Dec 2026 the scraper's lookahead will hit it — the degradation is logged-and-continue, so December/January would silently go missing.

B BAR ("Every Thursday") has no grid occurrence on Thu Dec 31 2026 (EAGLE LA NEW YEARS BASH!! that night) and none on Thu Jan 7 2027 is affected — is Dec 31 an MEC "not in days" exclusion or a cancelled night? The site gives no cancellation text.

CRUISE LA LEATHER & BOOTBLACK 2027 MEET & GREET (Oct 16) is on Eagle LA's calendar but its flyer says "@Rough Trade Gear". Should the bar override stand (as recorded) or does the owner want venue-site listings pinned to the venue?

CRUISE NIGHT (from Feb 6 2027) lists 23 dates through Aug 27 2027 on an irregular pattern (1st + 3rd Saturdays plus a 4th/5th Friday). What is the MEC rule? Needs the Feb 2027 grid, which currently 500s.

The scraper's /events/ door reads 12 rows and stops (page/2 is an empty shell); the real archive paging is mec_list_load_more. Is replaying it wanted, or is the month-feed lookahead (default 2 months) the intended reach?
